def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vlines=[j for j in range(w) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and g[0][j]!=0]
    hlines=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0]
    linecols=set(vlines)
    fills=[]
    for i in range(h):
        if i in hlines: continue
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if not v or j in linecols: continue
            ds=sorted(range(len(vlines)), key=lambda k: abs(vlines[k]-j))
            cands=[vlines[k] for k in ds if abs(vlines[k]-j)==abs(vlines[ds[0]]-j)]
            # drop ties whose mirror side segment lacks this color
            if len(cands)>1:
                def side_has(c):
                    if c<j: lo,hi=0,c
                    else: lo,hi=c+1,w
                    seg=[l for l in vlines if lo<=l<hi]
                    a=lo if not seg else max([x for x in seg if x<c] or [lo])
                    b=hi if not seg else min([x for x in seg if x>c] or [hi])
                    return any(g[r][cc]==v for r in range(h) for cc in range(a,b) if r not in hlines and cc not in linecols)
                good=[c for c in cands if side_has(c)]
                if good: cands=good[:1] if len(good)==1 else good
            c=cands[0]; m=2*c-j
            if 0<=m<w and g[i][m]==0 and m not in linecols and not any((j<l<m) or (m<l<j) for l in vlines if l!=c):
                fills.append((i,m,v))
    for i,m,v in fills: g[i][m]=v
    return g
